412fa150-ec71-5ea8-b3a3-a383f975e2d6.content: Retain a sharing draft temporarily only for as long as user review requires.

a54e2a4c-0faf-59e4-a4fc-3e6d0abc6ce3.content: Remove a draft rejected by the user from reusable working state.

d1b18256-a8c2-527e-bc9a-a545df84ae1a.content: Do not convey the content of an excluded Memory to the recipient.

aadaab1d-09d5-513a-96c9-3b47017c8ce6.content: Do not reuse a revoked sharing item in a later transmission.

edacfa1f-f50d-53de-a12e-39fb37cb3178.content: Removing a sharing draft does not delete the source local Memory.

3ab18116-6dd6-5f14-877a-3e3955230584.content: A recipient that does not receive a revocation notice may judge that the prior approval remains valid.
